what: A pale plate sits offset 5px to the lower right of the pill button like a shadow. On hover the button grows 1.1x over .5s on a curve that dips slightly and then overshoots, the plate folds under the button and disappears, and the background color changes. On release the plate unfolds along the same curve. Round icon buttons work the same way (plate 3px)

options.--fx-shift: Distance the boards are staggered (style), default 5px — original circle icon 3px
options.--fx-hover-bg: Color when raised (style), default --kf-accent-text — the original is green (site-specific color)
options.look: still: Doesn’t grow — the panel just folds and changes color

from.where: index.html·about.html·service.html .ak-btn — original .m-btn (240×60 navy pill, box-shadow 5px 5px 0 #bed4f7 → hover scale(1.1) · 0 0 0 · #30b589, transition all .5s cubic-bezier(.68,-.55,.265,1.75)), and .home-about-links .m-icon (30px circle, 3px plate) uses the same values
